title: SQLAlchemy ORM models
description: PositionORM, AccountORM, and OHLCVCacheORM in app/db/models.py, matching the fields documented in docs/architecture/API.md.

checklist.step: Define PositionORM (id, ticker, quantity, avg_cost_basis, entry_date)
Define AccountORM as a single-row table holding cash balance (single-user MVP)
Define OHLCVCacheORM keyed by ticker + date + interval, with fetched_at
Wire app/db/session.py (engine, SessionLocal, get_db dependency) to app/config.py's database_url
Add unit tests exercising CRUD against an in-memory SQLite session

decisions.decision: Verified the 4 pre-existing checklist items (PositionORM, AccountORM, OHLCVCacheORM, session.py wiring) against docs/architecture/API.md's documented field shapes and docs/architecture/Backend.md §7 before trusting the checkmarks, then added tests/unit/test_db_models.py (CRUD for all three ORM models against an in-memory SQLite engine created from Base.metadata) and tests/unit/test_db_session.py (engine wired to Settings.database_url, SessionLocal produces real Sessions, get_db's generator/finally-close contract). No code changes to app/db/models.py or app/db/session.py were needed — both matched the documented schema and wiring as written.
decisions.rationale: The task explicitly calls for verifying the existing checkmarks rather than trusting them; cross-checking against the API.md response shapes (Position fields, Account single-row cash, OHLCVCache composite key) and Backend.md's persistence section was the fastest reliable way to do that without duplicating a full architecture-review pass. Testing session.py's get_db dependency (not just the models) was included even though the checklist item only mentions CRUD, since the prior checklist item claims session wiring is done and that claim is just as easy to falsify with a cheap unit test.

review.notes: Diff scope: two new test files (backend/tests/unit/test_db_models.py, backend/tests/unit/test_db_session.py) plus task-board metadata; no production code changed (app/db/models.py, app/db/session.py were verified, not modified). Backend suite: 14 passed, 0 failed. app/db/models.py and app/db/session.py both at 100% line/branch coverage. Whole-repo coverage gate is unmet (58.18% vs 90%), but this is pre-existing on main (independently verified at 41.09% on a clean main worktree before this PR) and caused entirely by 0%-covered stub modules belonging to other not-yet-implemented tasks (app/data/*, app/indicators/*, app/signals/*, app/portfolio/*) -- this PR raises the number rather than dropping it, so it is not treated as a regression or blocker.
